hero.subheadline: VamoKora handles RSVPs, fair team drafts, cost splitting, and player ratings for real crews, every week.
hero.bio: I'm a full-stack developer and a Computer Engineering graduate from York University (2025), based in the GTA. I work in TypeScript, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, and Python, and I've shipped two products to people who aren't me: VamoKora, which I've been building since June 2026, and KonnectTaps, a digital business card platform I co-founded and built the frontend for. Most of what I care about as an engineer is in the decisions below — what I chose, and what it cost.

projects.title: VamoKora
projects.description: Pickup-soccer coordination for my own crew — RSVPs, team drafting, cost splitting, and player ratings — running real weekly games since June 2026.

projects.title: FootyTracker
projects.stack: Swift / SwiftUI / HealthKit / watchOS · in development
projects.description: An Apple Watch + iPhone app that records my soccer games and shows what Apple Fitness doesn't: playing time without bench and half-time, heart-rate zones, and a GPS heatmap on the actual pitch. I designed and directed it and use it in my own games; the Swift is written with an AI coding assistant. The call: never pause the workout. In a real game I forgot to tap "sub on" and lost the rest of the match, so bench time is now stored as time ranges instead of pauses. The cost: Apple Fitness and FootyTracker show different totals, on purpose.
